title: Change D into D minor
summary: Lower the highest sound a half step.

steps.title: Change D into D minor
steps.body:
Dm means D minor: D, F and A. Keep open string 4, fret 2 on string 3 and fret 3 on string 2. Move string 1 from fret 2 to fret 1, changing F# into F. Leave strings 6 and 5 out.

**Why it matters:** Comparing two similar shapes helps you hear exactly which note changes from major to minor.

steps.title: Read the positions
steps.body: The thin string supplies F4 at fret 1 instead of F#4 at fret 2. D and A stay where they were. Read x, x, 0, 2, 3, 1 from thick to thin.

items.prompt: Play D, A, F together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Compare the sounds
steps.body: Clear the selection between D and Dm. Move only string 1 and compare the two sounds. Take breaks; a relaxed hand matters more than speed.
